article.title: Shopify秋季更新：代理購物、商戶資料及本地付款同步擴展
article.title_en: Shopify’s Fall Edition expands agent shopping, merchant context and local payments
article.summary: Shopify於10月28日公布Fall ’26 Edition「Exponential」，把商品探索、Shop Pay結帳及店舖管理延伸至更多AI代理工作流程。
article.summary_en: Shopify’s October 28 Fall ’26 Edition, Exponential, extends product discovery, Shop Pay checkout and store management across more AI-agent workflows.
article.why: 零售品牌可把商品資料與政策治理、付款及代理渠道一併檢視，而非只追求在AI答案中出現。
article.why_en: Retail brands can assess product and policy governance, payments and agent channels together instead of focusing solely on AI-answer visibility.
article.next_step: 核對商店與市場資格，先更新商品、送貨、退貨及FAQ，再驗收一條代理探索至結帳路徑。
article.next_step_en: Confirm store and market eligibility, update product, delivery, return and FAQ information, then validate one discovery-to-checkout journey.
highlights: Shop.md提供可自訂的購物skill；公告亦列出Shop Pay在指定個人代理中的結帳安排。
商戶可覆核及批准提供給代理的政策、FAQ等資料；Shopify Payments新增付款方式包括Alipay、WeChat Pay及GrabPay。
highlights_en: Shop.md provides a customizable shopping skill, and the announcement describes Shop Pay checkout in named personal agents.
Merchants can review and approve policies and FAQs shared with agents; new Shopify Payments methods include Alipay, WeChat Pay and GrabPay.
article.detail:
Shopify於10月28日公布Fall ’26 Edition「Exponential」，把商品探索、Shop Pay結帳及店舖管理延伸至更多AI代理工作流程。

Shop.md提供可自訂的購物skill；公告亦列出Shop Pay在指定個人代理中的結帳安排。

商戶可覆核及批准提供給代理的政策、FAQ等資料；Shopify Payments新增付款方式包括Alipay、WeChat Pay及GrabPay。

零售品牌可把商品資料與政策治理、付款及代理渠道一併檢視，而非只追求在AI答案中出現。

核對商店與市場資格，先更新商品、送貨、退貨及FAQ，再驗收一條代理探索至結帳路徑。

各付款方式與代理接入的市場、商戶及渠道資格需分別確認；公告整體發布不代表每項功能全球同步可用，本刊未進行交易實測。
article.detail_en:
Shopify’s October 28 Fall ’26 Edition, Exponential, extends product discovery, Shop Pay checkout and store management across more AI-agent workflows.

Shop.md provides a customizable shopping skill, and the announcement describes Shop Pay checkout in named personal agents.

Merchants can review and approve policies and FAQs shared with agents; new Shopify Payments methods include Alipay, WeChat Pay and GrabPay.

Retail brands can assess product and policy governance, payments and agent channels together instead of focusing solely on AI-answer visibility.

Confirm store and market eligibility, update product, delivery, return and FAQ information, then validate one discovery-to-checkout journey.

Payment and agent integrations have separate market, merchant and channel requirements. An edition launch does not establish simultaneous worldwide access, and no transaction test was performed.
